title: fix(runtime,core): the action activation door switches an action no package ships, and keeps ADR-0112's code and status together
body:
Fixes #22817
Clause-②: yes

`POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/:object/:action` now switches an action no package ships, as its docblock declares (triage direction A, `6110327411`). The ledger row names the package that ships the action, and no package (`package_id` null) when none does. A refused ledger write keeps ADR-0112's code and status together. `InMemoryMetadataActivationStore.setActive` now refuses `packageId: ''` exactly as the durable store does.

## The defect, reproduced first on a real boot

Measured on `origin/main` `6364375b5` with a throwaway dogfood case (showcase boot, signed-in admin; the case was deleted after the run and is not in this PR). Two actions were saved through `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/:name` and then switched off through the door:

| Action | Door answer | Row |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `env_ping_global` (no object) | **503** `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, with "Activation row for action 'env_ping_global' names the empty string as its package. Omit packageId for an item no package ships; an empty package id is not a package." | none |
| `env_ping_task` (on the packaged `showcase_task`) | 200 | `package_id: "com.example.showcase"` |
| `showcase_mark_done` (packaged, control) | 200 | `package_id: "com.example.showcase"` |

- The 503 is the card's defect. The door wrote `String(action._packageId ?? obj._packageId ?? '')`, objectql's `setActionActive` passes the row to the store unchanged (`ActionActivationProjection.setActive`), the store refuses `''` with a `TypeError`, and the door's `catch` turned every undeclared status into 503.
- The card's reach says no row lands in either case. That is true only when the route object has no package either. When it has one, the row lands, and it is credited to the object's package, which does not ship the action. Triage's text for option A is "the door passes `undefined` for an action no package ships", so this PR covers that shape too.

What the declarations carry (same boot): an environment-authored action has `_provenance: "org"` and no `_packageId`. A packaged action has its own `_packageId` and `_provenance: "package"`, whether it is embedded or standalone. 73 platform actions declared inside their code objects' `actions` carry no stamp of their own (`sys_user:invite_user`, `sys_approval_request:approval_approve`, `sys_permission_set:clone_permission_set`, ...), so the object's package is the only record of who ships them.

## The fix

- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts`, step 5.** `shippingPackageOf(declaration)` asks the one "does a code package ship this?" predicate, `isCodeArtifactBody` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`, ADR-0029 D9.6). That predicate already excludes the `'sys_metadata'` sentinel and tenant provenance. The rule:
  1. the action's own package, when the action is a code artifact;
  2. for an action declared inside its object's `actions` (reference identity with the entry `resolveRouteActionDeclaration` returns), the object's package, when the object is a code artifact;
  3. otherwise none, and then the row is sent with no `packageId` key, so the store writes `null`.

  A tenant-authored action is never credited to a package.
- **Byte-identity, measured.** On the same showcase boot, over all 146 declarations the door can resolve, the new rule matches the old computation on 144. The two it changes are `env_ping_task` (`com.example.showcase` becomes none) and `env_ping_global` (`''` becomes none).
- **The door's `catch`** answers through `deps.errorFromThrown(err, 503)`, the dispatcher's one thrown-error rule, which #22811 adopted on the catalog door:
  - a record validation refusal is 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`;
  - the engine's declared pair (no ledger attached: 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`) is kept;
  - an undeclared throw is 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.
- **The docblock is corrected.** It said "Neither does the flow toggle". That has been false since `c8111a575`: `AutomationEngine.toggleFlow` refuses a flow no package ships (409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`), because such a flow has its own server-side switch, its definition's `status`. The docblock now gives the measured reason the action door differs: an action has no server-side switch of its own. `visible` and `disabled` are rendering predicates that no dispatch door reads (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`: objectui only). So the ledger row is the only switch an environment-authored action has.
- **`packages/core/src/utils/metadata-activation-store.ts`.** Both stores now call one `refuseEmptyPackageId`, so the in-memory double cannot accept a row the durable store refuses. The durable store's message is byte-identical to before.

### Is there a product reason against option A? (the stop clause)

Measured, and none was found. The flow toggle's refusal is the nearest one, and it rests on a property actions lack, as above. ADR-0126 §8 item 2 says the action leg "follows the flow legs". It lists what follows, "same `sys_metadata_activation` ledger, same §5 write authority, a consult point at action dispatch, a surface row", and none of those is a provenance gate. The door's authority (`manage_metadata`; the platform operator under `group`/`isolated`) is unchanged.

## Pins

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/action-activation-unpackaged.test.ts` (new, 10 cases). It runs over the REAL objectql `ActionActivationProjection` and `ObjectStoreActionActivationStore`, writing into a recording `sys_metadata_activation`, so it pins the door, objectql's pass-through and core's store together:
  - an object-less environment action switches off with 200, and the row is exactly `{ metadata_type: 'action', name, package_id: null, active: false }`;
  - switching it ON first writes the same package-less row, with `active: true`;
  - an environment action on a packaged object gets `package_id: null`;
  - the sentinel stamp and a tenant-authored `app.crm` binding both give `package_id: null`;
  - the switch is honoured: dispatch then answers 409 `ACTION_DISABLED` and the handler never runs;
  - **CONTROL:** an action stamped `crm` still writes `crm`, and an unstamped action embedded in a `crm` object still writes `crm`;
  - **faults:** a record validation refusal answers 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` and writes no row; an undeclared store failure answers 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and writes no row.

  The table double carries the store's `find` (bounded by `limit`, graded by `check:objectql-double-limit`) and `insert`, and no `update`. So `check:engine-double-contract`'s pinned ledger is unchanged. The update leg for a package-less row is core's, already pinned by "UPDATES its row with no package on the way back on".
- `packages/core/src/utils/metadata-activation-store.test.ts`:
  - the double refuses `''` with a `TypeError` whose message equals the durable store's, apart from the type in the subject, and keeps nothing;
  - the double keeps a row with no package, with `packageId` absent.

## Verification

- **Reverse verification**, at the final head `58b68fe15e`. The fix was committed first; `actions.ts` was replaced by its `6364375b5` bytes, then restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; blob `c989d1e62c` matched HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty. The new file went `7 failed | 3 passed (10)`. The 3 that stayed green are the two CONTROL pins and the undeclared-failure 503, which also answered 503 before the fix. The failures read exactly like the boot:
  - `{"code":"SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE","message":"Activation row for action 'env_ping_global' names the empty string as its package. ...","httpStatus":503}: expected 503 to be 200`;
  - `expected [ 'sys_metadata' ] to deeply equal [ null ]` and `expected [ 'app.crm' ] to deeply equal [ null ]`;
  - `expected 200 to be 409`: the disabled action ran;
  - `expected 503 to be 400`.
- **Ablation of the double's refusal**, with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete`. The anchor went from 1 to 0 and the blob changed, so the mutation landed. Result: `1 failed | 18 passed (19)`, with `expected undefined to be an instance of TypeError`. Restored: blob `b8fe921e55` equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. My first attempt passed `--replacement ""`, which the tool refused before running anything, so it measured nothing.
- **Who relied on the double's leniency:** nobody. Every construction site is a test: 1 objectql file and 6 service-automation files. All of them are green against the rebuilt core `dist`, which carries the marker: objectql `18 passed`, service-automation `152 passed`. No fixture needed triage.
- **The real boot after the fix:** the same throwaway case answers 200 for all three. `env_ping_global` and `env_ping_task` rows carry `package_id` null; `showcase_mark_done` keeps `com.example.showcase`.
- **Full suites**, on both the pre-merge head `cf606feddf` and the head merged with `origin/main` `55382dc02a` (`157a4dc138`), with the same figures each time:
  - `@objectstack/core`: 2373 passed;
  - `@objectstack/runtime`: 5061 passed, 19 skipped;
  - `typecheck` of both is green, including `check:test-typecheck`, which reached the new test file.

  The final head `58b68fe15e` changes only the new test file. There, the file passes 10 of 10 and `@objectstack/runtime` `typecheck` is green again.
- **Gates**, at `58b68fe15e`:
  - all 65 families `dispatch-gates --commands` derives, plus the dispatch-named `check:error-status-conformance`, each exited 0 with its exit code captured before any pipe;
  - `--ran` reconciles them: "65 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 65 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)";
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3), because eight packages outside this diff had no `dist/`. They were built and it was rerun: "107 published require entry point(s) across 66 package(s) load".
- **eslint** over the 4 changed TypeScript files at `58b68fe15e` (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 4 files reported, 0 errors, 0 warnings, none ignored. This is a narrowed run, not the repo-wide lint, which CI owns. The narrowing is safe because `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` lists the action switch as a packaged action's sanctioned path. That stays true, so no docs edit was needed.
- The flow toggle and the action door now draw different lines on purpose: flows refuse an unpackaged item, actions and the security catalog switch it. The reason is stated in the action door's docblock. If a reviewer wants one rule for the whole ADR-0126 family, that is a decision for a separate card. #22817 does not ask for it.
- `package_id` still has no reader that decides anything: the action hydrator reads `name` and `active` only, as measured in #22811.
